notes:
POC focus: build a 2-week pilot that ingests recorded calls, produces structured post-call summaries, QA scoring and coaching highlights. Key asks:
- Accurate speaker diarization and timestamped transcript (English US + occasional Spanish).
- QA rubric export: CSAT, compliance flags, soft-skills coaching bullets.
- Coaching highlights: 3 prioritized snippets per call with timestamps and suggested coaching prompts.
- Tool-calling: create/update Zendesk ticket and attach summary + tags via function call.
- Realtime agent-assist later phase: <500ms 95th pctl response for short prompts during live calls.
- Peak reliability: expect 4x baseline concurrency during promotions (they estimated 10k concurrent short sessions for contact center).
- Data handling: must support VPC endpoint, option to keep raw audio on-prem or set strict retention (7/30/90 day options).
- Preference for open-model variants for cost control (they mentioned Llama family), but open to Redwood-hosted optimized models if quantization & quality tradeoffs are documented.
- "We need coaching snippets to map back to our existing competency framework" — customer quote.
Shorthand: high cost-sensitivity, wants measurable unit cost per summary, cares about false-positive compliance flags (avoid too many false alarms).
poC_dataset: ~6k anonymized calls (US English primary, 12% Spanish). 3 channels stereo, average length 6m. Includes annotated QA labels for 1k calls.
technical_requirements: API-level function-calling to create tickets (Zendesk/SFDC), ability to run batching with prefix/KV cache, model pinning per rollout, quantization recommendations for Dedicated nodes, and tracing hooks for per-call latency breakdown.
pricing_notes: Shared sample pricing deck; prefer committed capacity for Dedicated if POC demonstrates 35-40% cost savings vs current vendor. Budget approved conditional on SLA and data residency guarantee.
risks: Legal/procurement timeline (DPA + security review) could push deal into enterprise procurement cycle. Unknowns around headcount growth affecting concurrency projections.
